properties.decision:
RECORDED AS AN IDEA, NOT A PRIORITY (@ajs, 2026-10-18: "let's record [it] as ideas for now, but it is not a priority").

WHERE IT CAME FROM: NSA's open-source LemonGraph (github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/lemongraph; README read 2026-10-18). Its stated primary use is "streaming seed set expansion": start from a few known items, keep taking data in, and keep asking what newly connects to them, with pattern queries over node→edge→node chains.

THE OVERLAP: it is the database form of option (d), A FEATURE-SCOPED ADOPT, which he kept as intent the same day in reflow2:dec:idea-what-adopt-takes-from-rea-reverse-engineer-anything. That option recovers only what is reachable from one literal seed, after REA's trace_application_feature. Here the same shape works at the store: a read, or a watch, scoped to everything reachable from a seed set in chosen directions, which updates as the design grows.

NOT CHOSEN; nothing to build. (d) itself is skill text and does not depend on this.
